theme_strategy.rationale: Citizens need a modern, professional, and trustworthy government service platform. A light theme conveys transparency, accessibility, and clarity. The Swiss approach removes clutter and focuses on raw data (issues, statuses, works) with high contrast for readability across all devices.

headings.rules: MANDATORY: tracking-tight. Maximum size for hero is text-5xl. Use for Page Titles, Dashboard Metric numbers, and Auth Headings.

body.rules: Highly legible for dense data, forms, and tables. Do NOT use Inter.

primary.description: Deep India Navy - Conveys absolute authority, stability, and trust.

citizen_portal.cards: Generous internal padding to prevent collision. Elements should have breathing room to feel approachable.

dashboard_staff_politician.spacing: Dense (gap-4 to gap-6, p-4 to p-6)
dashboard_staff_politician.cards: Every pixel utilized. Strict height matching using h-full. Grid items must be direct children of the container.

layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Grid Borders Pattern. Use flat backgrounds with a 1px crisp border (border-gray-200). Use Neumorphism (Tactile) exclusively for active toggles or small action buttons. No muddy glassmorphism.

component_guidelines.buttons: Square or subtly rounded (rounded-md max). High contrast text. MUST explicitly set hover states (e.g., hover:bg-gray-800).
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Left-align all labels. Use clear, distinct border colors for focus states (focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary).
component_guidelines.navigation: Header MUST have a solid white background (bg-white border-b border-gray-200) with z-50. Navigation links visible on desktop.
component_guidelines.tables_and_lists: Left-align data. Use subtle alternating row colors or strict bottom-borders (border-b border-gray-100).
component_guidelines.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all standard UI icons. Size should match the text-line height.

hero_login_bg.description: Rashtrapati Bhavan. Use as the background for the Login/Auth screen with a bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm overlay to ensure form readability.

development_works_thumbnail.description: Construction infrastructure. Use in the 'Development Works' feed or module cards.

schemes_rural_thumbnail.description: Indian village landscape. Use for Rural context cards, Schemes, or Village/Ward selector backgrounds.

accessibility_and_testing.data_test_ids: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over colored backgrounds must meet APCA standards. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for text-bearing elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind CSS and configure standard Shadcn UI components.
Implement the font imports (Outfit, Manrope) in the global CSS and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Follow the Control Room Grid protocol strictly for the Politician Dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
For the Citizen Issue Tracking timeline, use vertical borders (border-l-2) with the defined 'status' colors to map out 'New -> Review -> Assigned -> Resolved'.
Ensure the design feels like an official, trustworthy civic service platform, avoiding dark-mode 'hacker' or 'fintech-bro' aesthetics.
Never use generic placeholder images like via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the media_assets provided in this JSON.
